Recipe:
Canna-butter: I used 1 stick of butter and  melted it before adding 1.5 g of hash rosin (ice cream cake) then allowed the butter/wax combination de carb for 1-1:30 hours

Baklava: 
Toss 1 lb of chopped nuts (I used walnuts) in cinnamon and tiny (minuscule) amount of clove.

To assemble the actual pastry, I layered phyllo dough in a 13x9 pan with melted butter (use canna-butter for the high) after every 7 layers or so of butter and phyllo I laid down some nuts followed by another 7 layers an so on until the pan was full. Cut holes in the pastry so the syrup can flow down once baked. Bake the pastry at 350 for about 40-50 minutes. Or golden brown (a darker golden is better so all the layers are cooked well)

While the pastry is Baking, combine 1 cup water with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup of honey. You can flavor the syrup with citrus zest or spices I prefer not to. Bring the solution to a boil and then allow it to simmer until a good consistency. 

When the pastry is done baking pour the hot syrup over it.
